paragraphs: ICC Innovation is the arm of the International Code Council that packages digital tools and software as a service applications for communities. It is offered as an end-to-end suite backed by expert resources.

The lineup includes digital codification tools meant to support safety, compliance and efficiency. A flexible online code experience is offered to raise transparency and efficiency. Content management and process automation route work, requests and notifications so employees and residents can do business from anywhere. Permitting moves online, covering applications, inspection scheduling and application review. Electronic plan review is presented as a secure way to speed up the permit application process.

Training and certification options earn CEUs, LUs or PDHs toward International Code Council certification renewal. The Code Council is steered by a board that meets several times a year to provide oversight and strategic direction. The organization states its mission as building safety. Staff leaders run daily operations for their areas across the family of companies. One address it lists is in Washington, DC.
